Feature and fix PRs target `preview`. Release PRs merge the tested preview batch into `main`.

## Change

Describe the behavior, why it changed, and the part of the client it affects.

## Verification

List the checks run and their results. For UI changes, include desktop and narrow evidence. Call out relevant engine, live, or device coverage that remains unverified.

## Release note

Give a player-facing sentence if the change is visible in play. Internal changes can use `None`. Release PRs collect these notes into `CHANGELOG.md`.
